content.help: Master switch. Off bypasses all per-object controls and leaves the entire HUD under Bethesda behavior.
Defines when the global Low Health trigger becomes active.
Defines when the global Low Action Points trigger becomes active.

Press it in-game while the modded HUD elements are visible. Dynamic HUD performs discovery, writes configurable INI files to:
Data\MCM\Config\DynamicHUD\CustomElements
INIs can be edited while the game is running.
Master toggle for hiding button hint bar. Non-vanilla button hints might not get hidden.
Hides Pip-Boy button hint bar.

Hides button hint bar for:
Armor workbench, Chemistry station, Cooking station, Power armor station, Weapons workbench, Workshop.
Hides VATS button hint bar.
Hides Menus button hint bar.

Off — No HUD diagnostics.
Errors — Failures/warnings only.
Verbose — Startup, lifecycle, state, policy, gate, settings and periodic summaries.
Low-overhead sampled timing and hot-path counters. Intended for troubleshooting; off by default.

OFF — Bethesda controls this HUD element normally.
ON — Dynamic HUD controls it using Automatic and Mode.

OFF — Mode is ALWAYS HIDE / ALWAYS SHOW.
ON — Mode is HIDE or HIDE / SHOW and visibility follows the Show While conditions below.

HIDE — The mod may hide this HUD element, but Bethesda still decides positive visibility.
HIDE / SHOW — The mod may both hide and positively request native visibility.

ALWAYS HIDE — The mod continuously suppresses this HUD element.
ALWAYS SHOW — The mod continuously requests native visibility.

Automatic OFF: Hotkey is the only runtime trigger and flips the selected ALWAYS HIDE / ALWAYS SHOW baseline until pressed again.
Automatic ON: Hotkey counts as another Show While trigger.
Seconds to keep the HUD element visible before a Dynamic HUD-requested hide takes effect.
